stories.title: If you see a green beam over Talacre tonight, this is what it is
stories.summary: A green light beam will operate through the night at the Point of Ayr Terminal near Talacre from Monday 10 August 2026, to discourage birds from gathering in the demolition area. stories.summary: Two teenagers from North Wales have been charged with a series of offences after an incident in Foregate Street, Chester, Cheshire Constabulary said. stories.title: A-level results day is Thursday 13 August: how Clearing works and who to call
stories.summary: A-level results are published on Thursday 13 August, and students in Flintshire collect them from 8am. Anyone without a confirmed university place can add a Clearing choice through UCAS from 1pm the same day. The University of Chester said its Clearing hotline will open at 8am on Thursday and stay open through the following weekend.
